corpora.name: Poems (PoemHunter) Dataset
corpora.description: Enormous breadth spanning classical antiquity to 20th-century masters. Requires orthographic normalization and deduplication filtering.

corpora.name: Poetry Foundation Archive
keyMetadata: poetic forms (Sonnet, Villanelle, Sestina, Ballad, Blank Verse)
literary movements (Beat, Harlem Renaissance, Imagism, Metaphysical, Romantic)
corpora.description: The gold standard for structural taxonomy and curated literary metadata across British, American, and Anglophone traditions.

corpora.name: Chadwyck-Healey English Poetry Database
corpora.primarySources: Original printed editions and early manuscript copies
keyMetadata: first edition lineation and stanza indentation
corpora.description: The scholarly gold standard covering 1,300 years of the English poetic canon, providing unmodernized copy-texts with critical apparatus.

corpora.name: Old & Middle English Corpora (Anglo-Saxon & Early English)
corpora.curator: Exeter Book, Vercelli Book, Oxford Text Archive & Toronto Dictionary of Old English
corpora.primarySources: Exeter Cathedral Library MS 3501, Vercelli Cathedral MS CXVII, Cotton Nero A.x
corpora.description: All extant Old English heroic and elegiac poetry (Beowulf, The Wanderer, Cædmon's Hymn) with facing-page translations and Middle English texts.

corpora.name: Representative Poetry Online (RPO)
corpora.curator: University of Toronto Department of English & Ian Lancashire
keyMetadata: verified copy-texts with scholarly variant line notes
corpora.description: Exquisite scholarly editions with verified lineation, detailed footnotes, and structural metrical analysis for classroom and archival research.
